featured.title: Ship the Escalation Queue Before You Ship the Agent
featured.dek: Our audit agent ran three weeks without asking a human a single question — then a spot-check found eleven bad approvals. "Ask if unsure" in a system prompt is a fire exit sign with no stairs behind it. This one covers risk tiers, async escalation, staffing the queue like on-call, and feeding every human answer back into evals.
